findings.title: Plugin request logs lose traceID
findings.body: "Plugin Request Completed" no longer includes traceID. logRequest used to call tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) and append that value on every completion line, including unsampled traces. That extraction was deleted and not replaced: instrumentContext only sets endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname, and grafanaInfraLogWrapper.Info forwards to ConcreteLogger.Info(msg, kv...) without a context.Context, so a trace ID that exists only on the span is not read at log time. Completion logs can no longer be correlated with traces. pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, and dsUID are also no longer written on the line itself; they appear only if ContextualLoggerMiddleware ran earlier and FromContext merged WithContextualAttributes.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards recorded logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext ignores the receiver and returns NewTestLogger(), a different logger with empty counters. LoggerMiddleware now emits "Plugin Request Completed" via logger.FromContext(ctx).Info instead of logger.Info. Tests that hold a *TestLogger will not observe those calls, and the compile-time Logger assertion hides the broken fake. FromContext should return the same recorder (or a child that writes into the same Logs).

findings.title: Moved log fields have no test coverage
findings.body: Contextual attributes (endpoint, pluginId, datasource name/UID, user login) were moved out of LoggerMiddleware into ContextualLoggerMiddleware, and completion logs now depend on FromContext to surface them. The only test edit renames newInstrumentationMiddleware and still only asserts Prometheus counters. Nothing checks that instrumentContext attaches those fields, that LoggerMiddleware still emits them on "Plugin Request Completed", or that traceID is still present, so the dropped traceID and a broken FromContext merge would both pass CI.
